channel.title: Salt Lake Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Salt Lake Tribune (sltrib.com)

item.title: Taxpayers statewide should help Utah County fund the millions needed for the Charlie Kirk case, lawmaker says
item.description: When people accused of crimes can't afford their own defense attorneys, counties in Utah usually pay public defenders to represent them. So why is Utah County asking taxpayers statewide to contribute to the Charlie Kirk case?

item.title: In Utah, the host of ‘Call Her Daddy’ is making a sports competition show
item.description: Alex Cooper, the host of the popular "Call Her Daddy" podcast, is shooting a sports competition show in the Park City area, according to the Utah Film Commission.

item.title: Here’s a breakdown of Utah’s sweeping plan to hold back struggling third grade readers
item.description: SB241 would allow schools to hold back third graders who can't read at grade level. But it would also introduce more reading tests for younger students — and new supports. Here's everything that would change.

item.title: In major speech, LDS President Dallin Oaks says he wants to help all members ‘overcome present or future doubts’
item.description: At BYU, LDS Church President Dallin Oaks delivers his first major address at the faith's 18th prophet-president.

item.title: Tithing lawsuits against LDS Church might have been a bust, but here is what they did reveal
item.description: Three fraud lawsuits came against the LDS Church's tithing practices came — and three went. While none of the cases has succeeded, much was learned about the faith's vast finances along the way.

item.title: ‘Very concerning’: Utah lawmaker drafts bill after report finds most university trustees don’t understand their roles
item.description: Only about a quarter of university trustees in the state correctly answered recently what their role entails — even though it involves critical oversight of their school president and institution.

item.title: Peterka, Germany set to face off against Keller, USA in Olympic hockey group stage
item.description: The two Utah Mammoth forwards will go head-to-head in Italy.

item.title: Nathan Chen isn’t skating in Italy, but men’s figure skating still revolves around him
item.description: Four years after Salt Lake City figure skater Nathan Chen won Olympic gold, he'll be in Milan-Cortina for the 2026 Olympics. He won't be skating, but he will have influence on the outcome of the single men's competition.

item.title: The Triple Team: Lauri Markkanen and Jaren Jackson Jr. look like a formidable combo in first Jazz games together
item.description: What might Jaren Jackson Jr. and Lauri Markkanen do together on the court? Plus, a look at John Konchar, and a goodbye (sort of) from a Jazz beat writer.

item.title: The University of Utah has a new proposal for the Huntsman Center. Here’s what you need to know.
item.description: After considering building a new arena, the University of Utah has changed course on the Huntsman Center. Here's what the U. is planning now.
